title: AI Worm Hides in White Text and Hijacks Word Copilot
description:
White text on white background can hijack your Copilot 😳

Researcher Håkon Mølløy showed an AI worm for Copilot in Word: hidden prompts get read and excuted by the agent, which quietly edits financial numbers and copies itself into every new doc. Spreads via SharePoint, Teams, mail 🔥

Edit history stays clean, so audit sees nothing.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
